title: render "hierarchicalMenu"
body:
Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js. I could not find what I was looking for on the page "[hierarchicalMenu](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/hierarchicalMenu.html)".

<!-- Describe what you're looking for here. -->

comments.body:
Hi @eliprodigy, you didn't give any information in this issue. What do you have an issue with?

Can you create what you have so far in a sandbox environment? We have a template available for that purpose [here](https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/create-instantsearch-app/tree/templates/instantsearch.js). Thanks!

how can i catch click event on ais-hierarchical-menu--link
thanks

This isn't possible with the default widget, because we stop propagation of the event. The way to go here is to make your own custom hierarchical menu, or solving it without event listeners on the elements
do you have example for custom hierarchical menu please ?
do you have version without ES6 ?
on custom hierarchical menu i cant define "rootPath" do you know why please?
Maybe let's go over why you needed a custom widget in the first place. Why did you want to listen to the click events?

i want to get the path 
additional 
i cant set header "rootPath" when i use custom hierarchical menu

rootPath applies on a custom widget like it does on the default widgets, we do no custom logic in the component. 

If you are still struggling with this widget, 
can you create what you have so far in a sandbox environment? We have a template available for that purpose [here](https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/create-instantsearch-app/tree/templates/instantsearch.js). Thanks!
